class_rules.nested-git-metadata: any other path with a .git component, including .idx, hooks, and config
class_rules.pdf-binary: header starts with %PDF. Extension .pdf alone is not enough; a UTF-8 or empty body keeps a later class
class_rules.image: header PNG/JPEG/GIF/WEBP, or an image extension whose header was not text
class_rules.html-markup: header starts with <html, <!doctype, or <head after whitespace; wins over extension
class_rules.script: shebang in the 200-byte header, or extension .py/.sh/.bash, unless an earlier rule won
class_rules.json: extension .json, or utf-8 header starting with { or [ and extension is not yml/yaml/md/out/err/log
class_rules.log-stdout: extension .out, .err, or .log, including empty files with those extensions
class_rules.binary-other: NUL, non-utf8, or UTF-16 BOM, and no earlier magic rule
class_rules.empty: size 0 or empty header, and no earlier extension rule
class_rules.other: non-regular non-symlink, or header that matched nothing
